arguments.name: currencyName
arguments.description: The name of the new currency (e.g., "Australian Dollar")

raw.name: currencyName
raw.description: The name of the new currency (e.g., "Australian Dollar")

arguments.name: currencySymbol
arguments.description:
The symbol for the new currency (e.g., "AUD", "USD")
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters "USD."

raw.name: currencySymbol
raw.description:
The symbol for the new currency (e.g., "AUD", "USD")
NOTE: currencySymbol is not currency symbol like "$"; it is a combination of letters "USD."

arguments.name: isBaseCurrency
arguments.description: Set as base currency - accepts string "true" or "false" (default: "false")

raw.name: isBaseCurrency
raw.description: Set as base currency - accepts string "true" or "false" (default: "false")

arguments.name: exchangeRate
arguments.description: The exchange rate value relative to base currency (e.g., "1.45"). Not needed if isBaseCurrency is "true"

raw.name: exchangeRate
raw.description: The exchange rate value relative to base currency (e.g., "1.45"). Not needed if isBaseCurrency is "true"

arguments.name: confirmBaseChange
arguments.description:
Required if isBaseCurrency is "true"
Must be set to "true" to confirm changing the base currency

raw.name: confirmBaseChange
raw.description:
Required if isBaseCurrency is "true"
Must be set to "true" to confirm changing the base currency
